title: Wheelchair door rule needs level-access data the spec omits
why: Whether the 1000 mm rule applies depends on level access, which is not supplied.

spec.name: Wheelchair door rule needs level-access data the spec omits

exterior_doors.wheelchair_door_clear_wid.required: ≥ 1000 mm if the door offers level access, else ≥ 800 mm
exterior_doors.wheelchair_door_clear_wid.rationale: At 160 km/h, 4.2.2.3.2(2) applies if the door offers level access; the spec does not say. 900 passes 800 but fails 1000.
